# forbidden.js

@doc-version: 16.1.6
@last-updated: 2026-02-11

> This feature is currently experimental and subject to change, it is not recommended for production.

The forbidden file is used to render UI when the [`forbidden`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/forbidden) function is invoked during authentication. Along with allowing you to customize the UI, Next.js will return a `403` status code.

```tsx
import Link from 'next/link'

export default function Forbidden() {
 return (
 
 Forbidden 
 You are not authorized to access this resource. 
 Return Home 
 
 )
}

```

```jsx
import Link from 'next/link'

export default function Forbidden() {
 return (
 
 Forbidden 
 You are not authorized to access this resource. 
 Return Home 
 
 )
}

```

## Reference

### Props

`forbidden.js` components do not accept any props.

## Version History

| Version | Changes |
| --- | --- |
| `v15.1.0` | `forbidden.js` introduced. |

- API Reference for the forbidden function.
- [forbidden](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/forbidden)

---

events.content:
Here’s what was added and changed:

### 1. **`next.config.ts`** – enable auth interrupts

```typescript
experimental: {
  authInterrupts: true,
},
```

### 2. **`app/admin/page.tsx`** – admin page with role check

- Uses `verifyAdmin()` from your auth library
- Calls `forbidden()` from `next/navigation` when the user is not an admin
- Renders the admin dashboard when the user has the admin role

### 3. **`app/forbidden.tsx`** – custom 403 page

- Dark gradient background
- 403 status code and “Access Forbidden” message
- “Return to Home” link back to `/`

With the current mock in `auth.ts` (`role: 'user'`), visiting `/admin` returns a 403 and shows the forbidden page. To test the admin view, temporarily set `role: 'admin'` in `getSession()` in `app/lib/auth.ts`.

content.text:
Here’s what was added and changed:

### 1. **`next.config.ts`** – enable auth interrupts

```typescript
experimental: {
  authInterrupts: true,
},
```

### 2. **`app/admin/page.tsx`** – admin page with role check

- Uses `verifyAdmin()` from your auth library
- Calls `forbidden()` from `next/navigation` when the user is not an admin
- Renders the admin dashboard when the user has the admin role

### 3. **`app/forbidden.tsx`** – custom 403 page

- Dark gradient background
- 403 status code and “Access Forbidden” message
- “Return to Home” link back to `/`

With the current mock in `auth.ts` (`role: 'user'`), visiting `/admin` returns a 403 and shows the forbidden page. To test the admin view, temporarily set `role: 'admin'` in `getSession()` in `app/lib/auth.ts`.
